Overview.Title: Scheduler overview
Overview.Description: Review durable workload and recorded outcomes, then open the execution evidence that explains them.

Catalog.Title: Job catalog
Catalog.Description: Find owner-scoped definitions, inspect their effective cadence and execution evidence, and control future admission.

JobDetail.Title: Job details

Executions.Title: Execution ledger

Runtime.Title: Scheduler runtime
Runtime.Description: Inspect this host's local cycles and effective options, definition-backed owners in the shared scope, and optional service-registry observations.

Syntax.Title: Cronos syntax guide
Syntax.RuntimeContract: Field order is minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week; six-field mode prepends seconds.
Syntax.FieldTable: Cron field ranges and special characters
Syntax.Names: Months accept JAN–DEC and weekdays accept SUN–SAT, case-insensitively.
Syntax.ReversedRanges: Reversed ranges wrap across the field boundary, such as FRI-MON or 22-2.
Syntax.Steps: A step applies within its base range; */15 starts at the field minimum and advances by 15.
Syntax.DayMatching: When both day-of-month and day-of-week are constrained, Cronos requires both fields to match.

Tokens.Question: Any value for day-of-month or day-of-week
Tokens.Last: Last day of month or last named weekday

Examples.MonthlyFirst: At midnight on the first day of every month

Health.Title: Job health
Health.Description: Reliability, schedule delivery, terminal outcomes, and attempt duration are measured independently.
Health.ReliabilityFormulaHelp: Successful completions divided by successful plus failed completions; skipped and cancelled executions are excluded.
Health.FulfillmentFormulaHelp: Recurring schedule occurrences delivered to a worker, whether successful or failed, divided by delivered plus skipped occurrences. Triggered and operator run-now admissions are excluded.
Health.TriggeredFulfillmentNotApplicable: Triggered jobs have no automatic schedule to fulfill.

Coordination.Title: Who advances this scope
Coordination.Description: Owner coordinators advance recurring schedules. The maintenance coordinator recovers leases and runs bounded cleanup. Workers claim executions independently.
Coordination.CleanupNote: A cleanup timestamp records one bounded pass. This interface does not report completion of the whole-scope scan.
Coordination.ManualNote: A local in-memory store does not join shared-scope coordination. Automatic scheduling and maintenance are held.
Coordination.MissingNote: The replica advancing schedules cannot be determined. Local cycle readiness remains independent evidence.

OwnerDuty.active: Advances {0} of {1} owners, adding due recurring work to the execution queue.
OwnerDuty.standby: Other replicas advance recurring schedules. This host is on standby.
OwnerDuty.expired: {0} of {1} owner leases have expired. No valid local grant was observed.
OwnerDuty.none: This host publishes no job definitions and does not advance recurring schedules.
OwnerDuty.unobserved: No coordination observation is available to identify who advances recurring schedules.
OwnerDuty.manual: Automatic schedules are disabled. Run now remains available in the job catalog.

MaintenanceDutyNote.active: This host recovers expired execution leases and cleans history in bounded passes.
MaintenanceDutyNote.standby: Another replica handles recovery and cleanup. This host is on standby.
MaintenanceDutyNote.expired: The maintenance lease has expired. No valid holder was observed.
MaintenanceDutyNote.unobserved: No maintenance lease observation is available to identify the responsible replica.
MaintenanceDutyNote.manual: Lease recovery and history cleanup are disabled. Execution records stay in local memory.

Coordination.PublicationNote: Confirming an unchanged manifest updates its observation only. Its original publication time and fingerprint remain unchanged.
Coordination.NotOwnerProcess: Logical ownership is independent of process identity; one host can publish several owners.
Coordination.ManualOwners: Published owners in this isolated local store. Names open their local jobs.
Coordination.StoreBudgetNote: These limits apply to this process. Reserved slots protect renewal and finalization; they are not free-connection counts or measured throughput.
Coordination.ObservationNote: Validity is evaluated at this store observation, without a browser countdown. Refresh for new evidence.
